title: The Moon in the Bucket
youtube_title: The Moon in the Bucket | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small beautiful thing can be shared with the eyes only.
summary: At a harbor wall at low tide, Idris finds a moon sitting in a bucket of water. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Idris shows Felix how to look without disturbing it. the ferryman looks too, and they leave it where it is.
